topic: Write a Speech about How Music Has Helped You(写一篇关于音乐如何帮助你的演讲)
genre: 演讲 / 记叙+议论(speech about your favourite music / a band / why music matters)
source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 5 Reading for Writing:write a speech about how music has helped you or someone you know(讲述你与音乐的经历 + 音乐如何帮助你 + 运用比喻/拟人/引用等修辞)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,要在校园音乐分享会上做一个约100词的英语演讲。请讲述音乐对你(或你认识的人)的影响,内容包括:① 自我介绍并点明演讲主题;② 描述你与音乐的一段经历(如哪种音乐/哪支乐队帮过你);③ 说明音乐如何改变了你的心情或生活;④ 鼓励同学也让音乐成为生活的一部分。注意:适当用一两种修辞(比喻/引用/反问)。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Give a short speech (about 100 words) at a school music event about how music has helped you or someone you know. Include: 1) introduce yourself and your topic; 2) describe an experience with music (a kind of music or a band that helped you); 3) explain how music changed your mood or life; 4) encourage classmates to make music part of their lives. Use one or two rhetorical devices (a metaphor, a quote, or a rhetorical question).
points: 自我介绍 + 点题(It's an honour to share how music has changed my life.)
音乐经历(Two years ago, when I felt low, I found a band / a kind of music …)
音乐的作用(Music gave me strength and brought me relief.)
鼓励 + 修辞(Have you ever …? / Music is the medicine of the mind.)
model_essay: Good morning, everyone! My name is Li Hua, and it is an honour to share how music has changed my life. Have you ever faced a time when everything looked dark? Last year, before my exams, I felt tired and alone. Then I discovered a band whose gentle songs became the rock I leant on. When I listened, music gave me strength and brought me relief; somehow it lifted my spirits like a kite in the wind. As one writer said, "Music is the medicine of the mind." So whatever you are feeling, please make music a part of your life. Thank you!
model_translation: 大家早上好!我叫李华,很荣幸与大家分享音乐如何改变了我的生活。你是否曾遇到过一切看起来都很灰暗的时刻?去年考试前,我感到疲惫又孤单。后来我发现了一支乐队,他们温柔的歌成了我赖以依靠的磐石。当我聆听时,音乐给了我力量,也带给我宽慰;它不知怎地就把我的心情托起,像风中的一只风筝。正如一位作家所说:'音乐是心灵的良药。'所以,无论你有什么感受,请让音乐成为你生活的一部分。谢谢!

rubric.criteria: 四要素齐全:自我介绍点题 / 音乐经历 / 音乐的作用 / 鼓励同学
演讲层次清晰、有称呼与结尾、句句围绕中心、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、过去分词作状语等运用得当、含1-2种修辞、语法基本无误

required_structure: 称呼+点题 It's an honour to share how music has changed my life.
经历 Last year, before my exams, I felt … Then I discovered …
作用 Music gave me strength and brought me relief.
结尾鼓励 Whatever you are feeling, make music a part of your life. Thank you!
key_expressions: It is an honour to share how music has changed my life.
Music gave me strength and brought me relief.
It lifted my spirits like a kite in the wind.
As one writer said, "Music is the medicine of the mind."

high_sentences: It is an honour to share how music has changed my life.
Music gave me strength and brought me relief.
Moved by its gentle songs, I slowly found hope again.
Whatever you are feeling, the right music can make it better.

error_pairs.wrong: Move by the song, I felt better.
error_pairs.correct: Moved by the song, I felt better.
error_pairs.note: 主语 I 被歌曲打动(被动),状语用过去分词 Moved,不用原形 Move。
主语 Music 第三人称单数,动词加 s。

error_pairs.wrong: I'd like to share how music changed my life with you all happily.
error_pairs.correct: I'd like to share with you all how music changed my life.
error_pairs.note: share with sb sth 语序;避免状语堆在句末造成歧义。

paragraph_template:
【音乐演讲结构】
第1句 称呼+点题:Good morning! It's an honour to share how music has changed my life.
第2-3句 经历:Have you ever …? Last year, I felt … Then I discovered …
第4-5句 作用+修辞:Music gave me strength and brought me relief, like …
第6句 鼓励结尾:Whatever you are feeling, make music a part of your life. Thank you!
